framework.name: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria
framework.description: AICPA SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria covering Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, Privacy.

controls.title: COSO Principle 1 — Integrity and ethical values
controls.description: The entity demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values.

controls.title: COSO Principle 13 — Internal communication
controls.description: The entity internally communicates information necessary to support the functioning of internal control.

controls.title: COSO Principle 6 — Objectives
controls.description: The entity specifies objectives with sufficient clarity to enable identification of risks.

controls.title: COSO Principle 10 — Control activities
controls.description: The entity selects and develops control activities that contribute to the mitigation of risks.

controls.title: Logical and physical access controls
controls.description: The entity implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures over protected information assets.

controls.title: Authentication and authorization
controls.description: Prior to issuing system credentials, the entity registers and authorizes new internal and external users.

controls.title: Role-based access
controls.description: The entity authorizes, modifies, or removes access to data, software, functions, and other protected assets based on roles.

controls.title: Boundary protection
controls.description: The entity implements controls to prevent or detect and act upon the introduction of unauthorized or malicious software.

controls.title: Data transmission security
controls.description: The entity restricts the transmission, movement, and removal of information to authorized internal and external users.

controls.title: Malware protection
controls.description: The entity implements controls to prevent or detect and act upon the introduction of unauthorized or malicious software.

controls.title: Vulnerability detection
controls.description: The entity uses detection and monitoring procedures to identify changes to configurations.

controls.title: Security event monitoring
controls.description: The entity monitors system components and the operation of those controls for anomalies.

controls.title: Security event evaluation
controls.description: The entity evaluates security events to determine whether they could or have resulted in a failure.

controls.title: Incident response
controls.description: The entity responds to identified security incidents by executing a defined incident response program.

controls.title: Change management
controls.description: The entity authorizes, designs, develops or acquires, configures, documents, tests, approves, and implements changes.

controls.title: Risk mitigation
controls.description: The entity identifies, selects, and develops risk mitigation activities for risks identified.

controls.title: Availability — capacity management
controls.description: The entity maintains, monitors, and evaluates current processing capacity and use of system components.

controls.title: Availability — backup and recovery
controls.description: The entity authorizes, designs, develops, implements, and tests recovery procedures.
